priorityList: Invoke Xuen the White Tiger as your primary offensive cooldown for burst windows.
Use Zenith (Shado-Pan) while Xuen is active, or when Rising Sun Kick is on cooldown and you are nearing max charges.
Cast Celestial Conduit if Zenith is active and your primary spenders (RSK, FoF, SotW) are on cooldown.
Cast Fists of Fury as your highest priority spender, especially at 30 Flurry Charges or when Heart of the Jade Serpent is active.
Cast Whirling Dragon Punch whenever available (requires both Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick to be on cooldown).
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown for massive AoE damage.
Cast Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Use Spinning Crane Kick when Dance of Chi-Ji is active, prioritizing it if the buff is about to expire.
Cast Rising Sun Kick to enable Whirling Dragon Punch or when Zenith is active to maintain Flurry Strikes flow.
Use Touch of Death on low-health targets, prioritizing those that will die fastest.
Cast Slicing Winds as a priority filler to maintain Shado-Pan stacks.
Cast Blackout Kick with Combo Breaker procs or during Zenith windows to spend excess Chi.
Use Tiger Palm to generate Chi if you are below 2 Chi and near maximum energy, always respecting Combo Strikes.
Cast Spinning Crane Kick as your default Chi spender in AoE when no higher-priority abilities are available and you have 3+ Chi.
Activate offensive trinkets and racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) during Xuen or Zenith windows for maximum impact.
